content.en_us: Introduced as a consequence of a nuclear explosion.
Reintroduced as the first content block of the mod.

en_us.index:
---
flavor: "Look what we've done to the world."
---

# Introduction

{{"template":"referral","plural":false,"of":"self"}} is a block introduced in {{"template":"referral","of":"to_base:mod_version / yam:u1"}} and reintroduced in {{"template":"referral","of":"to_base:mod_version / to_sky_and_stars:0.1.0"}}. This block is leftover in the aftermath of a {{"of":"to_base:concept / to_sky_and_stars:nuclear_explosion"}}.

It is a slow block to mine. A {{"of":"minecraft:item / minecraft:netherite_shovel"}} with {{"of":"minecraft:enchantment / minecraft:efficiency"}} V is recommended - dropping when broken with {{"of":"minecraft:enchantment / minecraft:silk_touch"}}.

# Creation

This block is placed by {{"of":"to_base:concept / to_sky_and_stars:nuclear_explosion","plural":true}}, appearing more commonly at the edges of the blast.

This block is also generated by {{"of":"minecraft:block / to_sky_and_stars:nuclear_fire"}}.

# Gravity

When placed by a player or {{"of":"minecraft:block / to_sky_and_stars:nuclear_fire"}}, {{"of":"self"}} will be affected by gravity, similar to {{"of":"minecraft:block / minecraft:sand"}} or {{"of":"minecraft:block / minecraft:gravel"}}.

When placed by other sources, such as a {{"of":"to_base:concept / to_sky_and_stars:nuclear_explosion"}}, the waste will remain stationary.

Any floating waste will be ticked randomly in the game, and will eventually fall to the ground.

# History

{{"of":"self"}} in {{"of":"to_base:mod / to_base:yam"}}, {{"of":"to_base:mod / to_base:aimagg"}}, {{"of":"to_base:mod / to_base:lcc_forge"}}, and {{"of":"to_base:mod / to_base:lcc"}} would also be generated in a {{"of":"to_base:concept / to_sky_and_stars:nuclear_explosion"}} but was completely unbreakable by the player and would fall instantly (to reduce lag.)

In {{"of":"to_base:mod / to_base:lcc"}}, nearby entities without sufficient {{"of":"minecraft:item / to_sky_and_stars:hazmat_chestplate","text":"Hazmat equipment"}} would receive {{"of":"minecraft:mob_effect / to_sky_and_stars:radiation","text":"radiation poisoning"}} with the effect time stacking proportionally to the length of exposure. Additionally, standing directly on the block would constantly deal a quarter of a heart in radiation damage.

This block is the first content block added to {{"of":"to_base:mod / to_base:to_sky_and_stars"}}.
